quests.name: A Brother In Need
quests.objective: Find Aeonas in the Scarlet Monastery.
quests.description: Aeonas is in the rear chamber of the Cathedral. Finish Katherine's talk about Aeonas before you leave: players report that skipping it can block the next step. The chain before it (players' reports): the Strange Orb chain from Darkshore, then Katherine's quests from level 35.

turnIn.description: Aeonas, rear chamber of the Cathedral, inside the dungeon

quests.name: By The Light's Grace
quests.objective: Heal Aeonas (players report: to full health).
quests.description: Follows A Brother In Need, inside the Cathedral.

start.description: Aeonas, rear chamber of the Cathedral, inside the dungeon

quests.name: A Strange Artifact
quests.objective: Loot the Strange Orb on top of the Tower of Althalaxx in Darkshore and bring it to Delgren the Purifier in Ashenvale.

start.description: Strange Orb, top of the Tower of Althalaxx, Darkshore

turnIn.description: Delgren the Purifier, Maestra's Post, Ashenvale

quests.name: Earning Your Salt
quests.objective: Collect 14 Summoner's Salt from the Blackrock orcs in Redridge Mountains and return to Ursula Deline.

quests.objective: Collect 12 Motes of Mannoroth from the demons in Demon Fall Canyon, Ashenvale, then use the Spear of Mannoroth there to destroy the orb.

quests.name: Orders from the Grand Crusader
quests.objective: Players report: speak to the fishing trainer by the docks of Menethil Harbor, take the small boat south of the docks to Aeonas's hut on the coast, inspect the fallen Scarlet Crusader, defeat the level 40 elite assassin and loot the orders. Use them and return to Katherine the Pure.
